_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
I n'ye Wariyòrò {player_id} ye LinesOfAction wari la.
I ka kaw niw ye '{side}', sigidankè ka kaw niw ye '{other}'.
Wari format: `[b1b3]` (kònòw ka kèw ye - kònòw ka kèw ye). Wari-kèw ka kèw ye kònòw la, wari-kèw ka kèw ye kònòw la, walima kònòw ka kèw ye kònòw la, wari-kèw ka kèw ye kònòw la. I ka kaw niw ye sigidankè ka kaw niw ye kònòw la, nka sigidankè ka kaw niw ye kònòw la; kònòw la sigidankè ka kaw niw ye kònòw la.  I ka wari-kèw ye 8-kònòw ka kèw ye kònòw la, i ka wari bèèrè.

invalid_move.wrong_format: A ka kan ka kɛ e2e4 ye (ka bɔ, fo koordinɛtiw la).
invalid_move.no_piece: No {side} piece on {coord}. N bɛ na bɔ i ye, n bɛna taa ka aw yɔrɔ ɲini a la.
invalid_move.identical: A bɔyɔrɔ ni a taa yɔrɔ bɛɛ ye kelen ye.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: O ka kan ka kɛ siratilendon walima diagonalen.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: A ka kan ka tɛmɛ yɔrɔjan ni a bɛ bɛn fan fila ma.
invalid_move.destination_own: A ka baara kɛlen bɛ a yɛrɛ ye.

game_action.captured_suffix: Jokelani {player_id} donyi {from} -> {to}, a ka na kɛcɛyaa kɛ.

outcome.win: A fanw bɛɛ bɛ ɲɔgɔn na.
outcome.draw_no_capture: A bɛ taa ɲɛ 60 nka a tɛ se ka foyi sɔrɔ.
